name: Naiad Raider
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door

skills.name: athletics
note: when Shoving with their aqueous maul 17

items.name: Coral Armor
items.description: A good option for undersea explorers and aquatic peoples alike, coral armor consists of panels of carved coral. If worn underwater, some of this coral can even be alive.

generalAbilities.name: Animal Empathy
generalAbilities.description: The naiad can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Break Legs!
offensiveAbilities.description:
The naiad raider makes a maul Strike against an adjacent creature If it hits, the creature is knocked Prone and becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 minute As long as this clumsy condition lasts, the creature also takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speeds and has weakness 5 to the naiad raider's Strikes.

Effect: Break Legs!

offensiveAbilities.name: Rushing Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The naiad raider Strides twice If they end their movement within melee reach of an enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stampeding Shove
offensiveAbilities.description: The naiad raider Shoves a creature, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to their Athletics check if the target is Prone. If the Shove succeeds, the target takes 2d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage (double damage on a critical success).
